question: What is the cash prize amount included in the National Florence Nightingale Award 2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹1,00,000**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **President of India, Smt. Droupadi Murmu**, conferred the **National Florence Nightingale Awards 2026** to **15 nursing professionals** at Rashtrapati Bhavan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Florence Nightingale Award** honours the dedication, compassion, and resilience of the nursing profession.
 
• Instituted by the **Ministry of Health and Family Welfare**, each award includes a **Certificate of Merit**, a **cash prize of ₹1,00,000**, and a **medal**.
 
• These components symbolize the nation’s gratitude for the invaluable service rendered by health warriors.
 
• Hence, the correct cash prize amount included in the award is **₹1,00,000**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The awards were presented on the occasion of **International Nurses Day** (**May 12, 2026**).
 
• The theme echoed during the event was **"Our Nurses. Our Future. Empowered Nurses Save Lives"**, as remarked by the Union Minister of Health and Family Welfare, **Shri Jagat Prakash Nadda**.
 
• The awards are presented to **Registered Nurses, Midwives, Auxiliary Nurse Midwives (ANMs)**, and **Lady Health Visitors** serving across Central and State Governments, Union Territories, and voluntary organizations.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• To strengthen healthcare delivery, the Government of India is modernizing nursing education through the **National Nursing and Midwifery Commission Act**.
 
• A key initiative includes the establishment of **157 nursing colleges** co-located with medical colleges to build a skilled and empowered nursing workforce.
